recording_scope: Seven source-acquisition, classification, actual-field, count-decoding and adversarial commands. Packaging and final recursive verification are separate.
freeze_boundary: Every executed instrument is unchanged. Earlier dated checkpoints and pinned instruments remain unchanged. No new package dependencies, roots or measurement rows were introduced.
method_delta: Derive the complete field class from metadata by excluding an A4 normal closure using its cyclic cubic quotient, local wild ramification and Minkowski. Then determine exactly which arithmetic information a certified aggregate count contributes.
independence: Generator closure versus exhaustive subgroup subsets with opposite composition and cycle parity; square-class planes versus all sign-valued functions modulo 24; order trace discriminants and exhaustive projective nonintegrality checks versus round_two; multiplication characteristic polynomials versus Newton traces; factor-root template construction versus held-out aggregate roots; interval envelopes versus dynamic attainable-count sets; character coefficients versus 1128 local polynomial factorizations.
shared_backend_limits: Exact algebraic methods share Python and SymPy/FLINT in places. Independent formulations are not independent software stacks. Candidate spectral enclosures and completeness certificates are inherited and recursively verified; no new transcendental certification is claimed.
arithmetic_scope: The written arithmetic bridge is supported by primary references and finite checks but is not a Lean proof. Two actual A4 fields show that dropping ramified-prime support or the small 3-adic discriminant exponent invalidates the obstruction.
information_scope: The original benchmark remains valid for its restricted decoder. A more informed decoder uses the complete metadata class and distinguishing count, so prior sufficient Gaussian noise radii do not characterize the information available in this richer model.
history_policy: Keep all 117 branch IDs, preserve the 418-event byte prefix and append five events. Research remains active without global completion.

verification_attempts.rerun: The v2 verifier checks new science/provenance before repeating the complete prior recursive replay. Final verification receipt remains separate from the seven scientific/source commands.
